messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — tenant=taurus (enterprise, VPC) increased 5xx rate in eu-west-1 on dedicated pool ded-42. Severity: P1. Pager: oncall-sre
maria: ack'ing. I'm oncall. seeing ~18% 5xx for taurus progeny routes. Errors look like model-attach failures, not auth.
akash: on my way. any downstream/edge errors or TCP drops? packet counters on LB? 
jordan: network team — we see SYN retries from ded-42 -> model-hosts in eu-west; CPU on model-hosts is fine. tailing logs now.
maria: customer impact: taurus reported elevated latencies and some request failures for live agents. darwin (taurus SRE) messaged CSM. Sophie, can you confirm customer visibility and whether they have failover config?
sophie: Sophie here. Taurus confirmed failures for some critical endpoints. They have a warm pool in us-west-2 but it is not traffic-ready because of firewall CIDR differences. They'll open the fw to our us-west-2 egress if we coordinate. darwin is online.
lee: Account-eng chiming in — will notify execs and legal if we need IP changes. They want a least-risk plan.
maria: immediate triage: isolate whether problem is infra (dedicated pool) vs model binary. Jordan, can you validate model-host health in eu-west-1 and whether node-level oom/crashloops? 
jordan: model-hosts healthy, but one proxy daemon on ded-42 is restarting (conntracking leaks). Restarted it on two nodes, errors dropped from 18% to 12% but still above baseline. Looks like stateful connection leak under specific Tenant session patterns.
akash: given partial recovery, recommend traffic-shift plan to use Taurus' warm pool in us-west-2 while we mitigate. This is enterprise/VPC — we need Taurus to open firewall and accept traffic. Sophie confirmed they'll do that. Plan: staged cutover via Redwood routing policy (not DNS) so we can rollback fast. Steps:
1) PREP: run synthetic warmup to populate KV caches on us-west-2 and verify latencies.
2) CANARY: route 10% of Taurus traffic to us-west-2 for 5m, monitor 5xx and p50/p95.
3) RAMP: 50% -> 5m -> 100% if metrics stable.
4) FALLBACK: immediate policy rollback to eu-west-1 on any error spike >3% in 5m window.
maria: +1. Important: because Taurus is VPC/private, we must ensure egress IPs match firewall rules — Sophie please confirm CIDR/timestamps.
sophie: they will add us-west-2 egress CIDR 3.120.12.0/24 now, ETA 7m. Confirming with darwin.
lee: I'll update Taurus execs and ask to expedite. 
jordan: pre-warm: running 2k synthetic requests at 5rps across model versions in us-west-2 now. curl health endpoints:
```bash
for i in {1..2000}; do curl -sS -X POST https://us-west-2-internal.redwood/api/v1/taurus/health -d '{"probe":true}' & done
```
akash: watching metrics: kv cache hitrate in us-west-2 at 0 -> warming. p95 currently 220ms, okay. dedicated pool capacity ok.
maria: Sophie/watch: once firewall opened, I'll flip routing to 10% via the routing-policy UI. Who will execute? 
akash: I'll execute the routing change. maria, you'll monitor; Jordan handle infra rollback. Sophie coordinate customer-side checks.
incident-bot: Paging akash for oncall handoff — next shift at 1792110200 UTC.
maria: Doing canary now — switching 10% to us-west-2.
akash: change applied. metrics starting to route. 
maria: first 5m: 5xx down to 4% on canary traffic (good), overall 5xx 9% (old pool still noisy). No new error types seen. p50 on canary 200ms, p95 310ms.
jordan: infra: connection leak remediation continues. We're patching conntrack config on ded-42 nodes. If that holds we can consider partial return.
sophie: Taurus confirms they allowed the CIDR and see model responses from us-west-2 in their metrics. darwin says no firewall errors.
akash: ramping to 50% now.
maria: monitors green at 50% for 6m. Synthetic checks no regression. proceeding to full 100%.
akash: switched 100% to us-west-2. Observability: 5xx ~1.1% now, latency stable. Rolling restart of proxy on ded-42 in eu-west-1 continues.
jordan: that restart seems to have reduced internal errors; once proxy patch is complete and conntrack settings hardened we can re-evaluate returning traffic.
lee: Noting for customer comms: told Taurus execs we did a controlled failover to us-west-2, full recovery, working on root cause and returning when safe.
maria: Ready checklist for return: confirm patched nodes healthy for 30m, no spike >1% 5xx, KV caches warmed on eu-west-1. If all good, we will do inverse canary (10% back -> 50% -> 100%) during low-traffic window.
akash: Oncall handover: I'm staying on for next 60m, then Tom will take over at 1792110800. Tom, you're briefed.
tom: got it. I'll monitor and own postmortem writeup once incident stable.
incident-bot: RESOLVE — Incident marked mitigated at 1792110450. Impact: Taurus traffic fully on us-west-2; eu-west-1 dedicated pool still under remediation. Owner: maria. Postmortem assigned to tom.
maria: Thanks team. Sophie please coordinate final customer update and schedule a joint runbook review with Taurus to reduce future blast radius from conntrack issues. Tom — please open incident doc and link logs.
